## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the commands and results you actually obtained. Note checks you could not run.
For a visual change, include sanitized screenshots or a short recording.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe relevant migration, API, permission, localization or deployment effects.
Write "None" when no such changes apply.

- [ ] This request has one clear scope and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] New behavior or a bug fix has appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Shared UI text and regional/RTL behavior were considered where relevant.
- [ ] The diff and evidence contain no credentials or real customer data.
